acceptance.assertion: The three controller test suites use an explicit temporary source root and no longer depend on repository-local artifacts while still asserting the canonical artifacts/<name>.json default path shape.
Calling each controller without options continues to resolve artifacts and fixtures relative to process.cwd(), with unchanged environment override, strict-mode and fixture-fallback behavior.
Focused and full tests pass both in the normal checkout containing runtime artifacts and in an isolated worktree/root without those artifacts.
The change adds no network dependency, mutation authority, artifact creation or controller state; it only selects read roots before existing read-only loading and validation.

goal: Make Bureau, checkout and storage-health controller tests deterministic when repository-local runtime artifacts exist by introducing an explicit test-only source root boundary while preserving all production default paths, fallback rules and read-only semantics.

does_not_establish: absence of unrelated future test pollution
future absence of unrelated test pollution
metadata.outcome: Leitstand PR #202 isolated Bureau, checkout and storage-health controller tests from repository-local runtime artifacts by adding an optional sourceRoot boundary that defaults to process.cwd(). The exact reviewed head passed focused tests, typecheck, lint, build and the complete 272-test suite both without and with copies of the three real runtime artifacts, then merged cleanly to current main.

evidence.environment: isolated worktree with copies of canonical bureau-tasks, checkout-inventory and storage-health artifacts

evidence.result: 22 focused tests passed; typecheck, lint and build passed

isolated-default-path-tests.evidence: All three suites create temporary source roots; fixture tests copy only the required tracked fixture into that root. Missing-path assertions remain artifacts/<name>.json and pass even when real repository artifacts exist.

production-defaults-unchanged.evidence: Each controller resolves options.sourceRoot ?? process.cwd(); new regression tests assert the no-options path remains process.cwd()/artifacts/<name>.json. Existing environment override, strict and fixture fallback branches are unchanged.

read-only-scope.evidence: The diff adds only root selection before existing filesystem reads and path display. No network call, artifact write, execution authority or mutable controller state was introduced.
